name: COMP_002
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (82%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Reliability is flagged, two classes share the 90% conformal set, and the second model disagrees. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 82%, Benign 15%, Invasive 2% | One clear leader |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.67 flagged, OOD 84th percentile | Input itself suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top class differs |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 InSitu | Neighbors mostly disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Normal-lobule score above typical; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Benign stroma score above typical · Validated [F4]
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Peaks in one region; overall invasive probability 2% · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; bears on in situ versus benign · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect classifier; normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image quality degrades the read: reliability is flagged (0.67).
- Lesion is Benign rather than InSitu; MUSK disagrees and only 1 of 5 neighbors is InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 1**: check for atypical cells confined within ducts, separating in situ from benign.
2. **Regions 3, 0, 2**: top heatmap contributions toward invasive; region 2 per-region risk is 84%.
3. **Region 8**: strongest tumor-infiltrating-stroma score (spot check 19/20); confirm whether invasion is present.
